author: Mark Atwood
text:
Re-classifying as 'won't fix here' per workspace canonical-template propagation rule. The Mutex .unwrap() pattern is workspace-wide:

- jmap-mail-server (CANONICAL): 31 sites in src/memory.rs, no documented policy.
- jmap-metadata-server: 23 sites (this bead's scope).
- 6 other extension-server siblings: unaudited but expected to share the pattern.

Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates': 'If you reshape this crate in a way that diverges from jmap-mail-server, change jmap-mail-server first, then propagate to every other extension-server sibling in the same pass.' A metadata-server-only fix would create a divergence; documenting a panic policy only here while the canonical and 6 siblings keep bare .unwrap() is exactly the cookie-cutter regression the rule guards against.

Filed canonical-first sweep epic: JMAP-pk88 (jmap-mail-server canonical + 7 sibling propagation). Closing this sibling-scoped bead in favor of that one.
